changes.comment: BREAKING: an open JsonSchema object (additionalProperties: true, including every fromJson object without additionalProperties: false) now carries undeclared keys through as validated JsonValue instead of silently dropping them, refuses a non-object input instead of converting it to {}, and states additionalProperties: true on the wire. Adds OpenObjectStatic and typed object() overloads for additionalProperties: true. Fixes a latent defect in Converters.jsonObject: a parsed "__proto__" key is now copied as an own property instead of replacing the result's prototype.
